## Process rules (learned the hard way)
1. Counts come from `validate.py` + direct reads. Running tallies in chat drift — never trust them.
2. Verified-only: full stem + options + key from ≥2 sources or certain derivation. Anything less is dropped or never added.
3. `python3 validate.py` must stay 0 ERRORS after every change.
